method: Representative source-family inspection before scaling: raw foil and etch paired with unchanged full-card TCGL fronts and colored coverage overlays. Center, rounded corners, name/HP, evolution portrait, attack glyphs and lower rules align with no crop, flip or offset. White groove strokes use the reference recessed polarity. Remaining cards undergo deterministic pairing/dimension/hash validation, not individual physical calibration.
providerCaveat: Ascended Heroes Erika's Oddish ph and ph2 foil URLs return byte-identical energy-pattern PNGs. Preserve provider assets and printing identity; never synthesize the missing ball motif. Batch audit must report all such pairs.
limitations: Source families are visually registered, but TCGL does not measure physical depth. Card-specific opaque-body estimates reuse the existing converter. Independent angled-photo calibration and manually traced region masks for every card are outside the requested batch pass. Physical optics for Mega Attack Rare and Mega Hyper Rare remain deferred to Astra High.
